verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://trigger.dev/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with agent-oriented content, and an llms-full.txt also exists. Docs pages are served as markdown (.md URLs), and there are dedicated agent resources: a 'Building with AI' page, portable Skills instruction sets for AI coding assistants, and an MCP server that can search the docs. Missing for 10: no independent community or hands-on report of agents actually consuming these docs effectively (the root /docs.md path also 404s).
